scope: Typed common ACAD_REACTORS group-330 and ACAD_XDICTIONARY group-360 output from DRW_TableEntry metadata.

behavior: Typed reactor source IDs reject zero and DRW::NoHandle.
Typed extension-dictionary source IDs reject DRW::NoHandle; zero remains the absent-edge value.
The writer computes the typed output IDs before publishing either generated group, rejects DRW::NoHandle results from resolver or remap, and rejects zero results from the direct remap path.
The configured callback resolver's existing zero-result behavior remains unchanged and omits that optional typed edge.

focused.coverage: ASCII/Binary typed DICTIONARY records: invalid reactor and XDICTIONARY source IDs, zero/NoHandle direct-remap results, and NoHandle resolver results all refuse with empty output.

limitations: This proves typed ID representation and preflight only; it does not prove target existence, ownership, target kind, recursive closure, or physical producer support.
A callback resolver result of zero retains the preexisting optional-edge omission behavior.
Explicit retained ACAD_REACTORS and ACAD_XDICTIONARY groups in appData are not qualified by this receipt.
next: Continue source- and role-backed common-reference closure; keep optional resolver omissions and retained raw app-data profiles separate from typed ID validation.
